fixed_predictor_source.rule: Use the stored scaler mean/scale, logistic coefficients/intercept and threshold 0.5 exactly; no retraining or recalibration.

purpose: Confirm or falsify the v0 learned seeded-start gate on a new positive-enriched but still untouched family chosen after v0 showed both its train/test positives in quartic regular graphs. Because family selection is outcome-aware, only these new seeds can provide confirmatory evidence and results must remain scoped to quartic n=16 graphs.

seeded_start.choice: same max-min normalized Kendall rule as v0

features: exact v0 19-feature vector before any seeded BDD compilation
label: seeded strictly beats natural and RCM after one local-search stage; ties negative

policies.always_three: same v0 three-arm controller, max 2 accepted moves

predeclared_tests: Report label prevalence and fixed learned-gate TN/FP/FN/TP; if zero positives, recall is inconclusive rather than perfect.
Primary safety: report every learned-gate false negative and its final live-node regret relative to always_three.
Primary efficiency: compare learned_gate vs always_three candidate compilations and summed final live nodes.
Explicit baseline: compare against the preexisting width+1 gate on the same frozen seeds; unlike v0 this comparator is preregistered.
All endpoints must match exhaustive truth bitset/Hamming-rank oracle.
Do not change model, threshold, seeds or label after outcomes.
scope: Outcome-aware family-focused confirmation only; no generalization beyond this fixed quartic n=16 synthetic graph distribution.
